```{python}
#| context: setup
import polars as pl
from plotnine import *
from shiny import render, reactive, ui as core_ui
from shiny.express import input, ui
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Read data
us_counties = pl.read_parquet("data/us_counties.parquet")
us_states = pl.read_parquet("data/us_states.parquet")
us_hex_positions = pl.read_parquet("data/us_hex_positions.parquet")
us_atc_county_polygons = pl.read_parquet("data/us_atc_county_polygons.parquet")
us_large_cities = pl.read_parquet("data/us_large_cities.parquet")

# Add below/above counts to us_states
below_counts = (
    us_counties.filter(pl.col("pred_status") == "below")
    .group_by("state")
    .agg(pl.count().alias("below"))
)
above_counts = (
    us_counties.filter(pl.col("pred_status") == "above")
    .group_by("state")
    .agg(pl.count().alias("above"))
)
us_states = us_states.join(below_counts, on="state", how="left").join(above_counts, on="state", how="left")
us_states = us_states.with_columns([
    pl.col("below").fill_null(0),
    pl.col("above").fill_null(0)
])

# Prepare state list
state_list = ["All US"] + sorted(us_states["state_name"].to_list())

us_choices = ["Population", "No. of Hospitals", "Below model", "Above model"]

def format_number(x):
    """Format large numbers with K/M suffix"""
    if x >= 1_000_000:
        return f"{x/1_000_000:.1f}M"
    elif x >= 1_000:
        return f"{x/1_000:.1f}K"
    else:
        return str(int(x))

def create_hex_polygons(centers_df, size=0.5):
    """Create hexagon polygon coordinates from center points"""
    import numpy as np

    hexagons = []
    for row in centers_df.iter_rows(named=True):
        angles = np.linspace(np.pi/6, 2*np.pi + np.pi/6, 7)
        hex_x = row['x'] + size * np.cos(angles)
        hex_y = row['y'] + size * np.sin(angles)

        for i in range(len(angles)):
            hexagons.append({
                'state': row['state'],
                'state_name': row['state_name'],
                'x': hex_x[i],
                'y': hex_y[i],
                'order': i
            })

    return pl.DataFrame(hexagons)
```

### Column

```{python}
@render.express
def population_box():
    selected = input.state()
    if selected == "All US":
        data = us_states
    else:
        data = us_states.filter(pl.col("state_name") == selected)
    total = data["population"].sum()

    ui.value_box(
        title="Population",
        value=format_number(total),
        showcase=ui.HTML('<i class="bi bi-person"></i>'),
        theme="blue",
        showcase_layout="bottom"
    )
```

### Column

```{python}
@render.plot
def state_map():
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    # Get selected state data
    selected = input.state()

    # Determine variable to plot
    view = input.view()

    if selected == "All US":
        # Create hex map for US states
        plot_data = us_states

        if view == "Population":
            var = "population"
            fill_label = "Population"
            high_color = "#0072B2"
        elif view == "No. of Hospitals":
            var = "hospitals"
            fill_label = "Hospitals"
            high_color = "#0072B2"
        elif view == "Below model":
            var = "below"
            fill_label = "Underserved"
            high_color = "#CC79A7"
        elif view == "Above model":
            var = "above"
            fill_label = "Overserved"
            high_color = "#0072B2"
        else:
            var = "hospitals"
            fill_label = "Hospitals"
            high_color = "#0072B2"

        # Join state data with hex positions
        hex_data = us_hex_positions.join(
            plot_data.select(["state", var]),
            on="state",
            how="left"
        )

        # Create hexagon polygons
        hex_polygons = create_hex_polygons(hex_data)

        # Join polygons with fill values
        hex_plot_data = hex_polygons.join(
            hex_data.select(["state", var]),
            on="state",
            how="left"
        )

        p = (
            ggplot(hex_plot_data.to_pandas(), aes(x="x", y="y", group="state", fill=var)) +
            geom_polygon(color="#cccccc", size=0.5) +
            geom_text(
                data=hex_data.to_pandas(),
                mapping=aes(x="x", y="y", label="state"),
                size=8,
                color="black"
            ) +
            scale_fill_gradient(low="#ffffff", high=high_color) +
            coord_fixed() +
            labs(title=f"United States - {fill_label}", fill=fill_label) +
            theme_void() +
            theme(
                legend_position="bottom",
                figure_size=(10, 6)
            )
        )
    else:
        # County-level geographic map
        plot_data = us_atc_county_polygons.filter(pl.col("state_name") == selected)
        city_data = us_large_cities.filter(pl.col("state") == plot_data["state"][0]).filter(pl.col("position") <= 3)

        if view == "Model":
            var = "pred_status"
            fill_label = "Model results"
            use_categorical = True
        elif view == "Population":
            var = "population"
            fill_label = "Population"
            high_color = "#0072B2"
            use_categorical = False
        elif view == "Hospitals":
            var = "hospitals"
            fill_label = "Hospitals"
            high_color = "#0072B2"
            use_categorical = False
        else:
            var = "hospitals"
            fill_label = "Hospitals"
            high_color = "#0072B2"
            use_categorical = False

        if use_categorical:
            p = (
                ggplot(plot_data.to_pandas(), aes(x="x", y="y", group="group", fill=var)) +
                geom_polygon(color="#cccccc", alpha=0.6) +
                geom_point(data=city_data.to_pandas(), mapping=aes(x="x", y="y"), inherit_aes=False) +
                geom_text(
                    data=city_data.to_pandas(),
                    mapping=aes(x="x", y="y", label="city_name"),
                    inherit_aes=False,
                    ha="right",
                    nudge_x=-0.1
                ) +
                scale_fill_manual(
                    values={"above": "#0072B2", "below": "#CC79A7", "ok": "#009E73"},
                    labels={"above": "Above", "below": "Below", "ok": "At Level"}
                ) +
                coord_fixed() +
                labs(title=f"{selected} - {fill_label}", fill=fill_label) +
                theme_void() +
                theme(
                    legend_position="bottom",
                    figure_size=(10, 8)
                )
            )
        else:
            min_val = plot_data[var].min()
            max_val = plot_data[var].max()
            p = (
                ggplot(plot_data.to_pandas(), aes(x="x", y="y", group="group", fill=var)) +
                geom_polygon(color="#cccccc", alpha=0.6) +
                geom_point(data=city_data.to_pandas(), mapping=aes(x="x", y="y"), inherit_aes=False) +
                geom_text(
                    data=city_data.to_pandas(),
                    mapping=aes(x="x", y="y", label="city_name"),
                    inherit_aes=False,
                    ha="right",
                    nudge_x=-0.1
                ) +
                scale_fill_gradient(low="#ffffff", high=high_color) +
                coord_fixed() +
                labs(title=f"{selected} - {fill_label}", fill=fill_label) +
                theme_void() +
                theme(
                    legend_position="bottom",
                    figure_size=(10, 8)
                )
            )

    return p
```
